lines.text: Crows can remember your face. For years.
And that's not even the weird part.
In Seattle, scientists put on a scary caveman mask, and trapped seven crows.
After that, anyone wearing that mask got scolded and dive-bombed. A different mask? Ignored.
Hat on, mask upside down. They still knew.
And the weird part? Crows that were never caught joined in. They learned the face from other crows, and kept the grudge for years.
